source_facts.finding: Generic current SQL proof gate accepts a function-supplied literal closed operation list and permission; it does not need a parent SQL operation registry edit. Own function must additionally validate exact environment target/allowed/path/scope/current identity, caller/profile and revision.

Current attestation verifies HMAC over exact authenticated bytes and bounded validity; context seal includes session_user and current transaction ID. A future registered Go operation can use the generic existing fence, but an old/stored proof cannot delegate across transactions.
Go proof serialization looks up the compiled explicit operation registry. Unknown names cannot acquire a purpose by supplying raw SQL operation text.
Actual current QueryJSON requires current request grant and exact statement classifier; adding a native function alone leaves the new product route unavailable, rather than authorizing it.

Current resolver/fence already supports the existing selected environment resource and version. NEW explicit environment-scope operation policies can avoid inventing a Device authorization source kind.

Original registered discovery API Device/token writers use current organization serialization. This validates native caller and lock order, not user OpenFGA permission; a new API wrapper must require its own current human request purpose.

Current80 authenticate-enrollment wrapper replaces original token expiry with clock_timestamp after organization/device serialization; own native enrollment admission still needs final expiry/state/generation confirmation after all own waits/writes before commit.

Actual native15 enrollment accepts locator/secret and exact credential/generation/key/public-key/expiry tuple, hashes the tuple and returns stable same-intent replay for an already-consumed enrollment. A conflicting tuple is rejected. Existing authenticated token lookup is still required, so expiry can prevent later replay and must not be hidden by a fresh identity or key.

Actual runtime gateway consumes a closed local credential file with credential_id/key_id/private_key; command custody must produce that exact format only after confirmed enrollment and preserve pending key/intent through unknown outcomes.

smallest_coherent_next_launch_batch.native_transport: A fixed enrollment route is unauthenticated by Device only because a Device credential does not yet exist; it authenticates the original enrollment token locator/secret and derives native scope/Device from that authority. Closed bounded body, no caller-trusted scope, no arbitrary URL/redirect/secret logging. Calls actual current15 authenticate/enroll through the original gateway-control pool/registered caller.
smallest_coherent_next_launch_batch.local_custody: CLI generates Ed25519 private key and fixed credential ID/key ID/generation/expiry intent once, durably before sending. Private key remains local in pinned regular0600 pending custody; exact pending intent is retained across crash/unknown COMMIT, never replaced by a new key for a retry. Original enrollment token comes via bounded stdin, never argv/log/report or persistent pending metadata. Only confirmed typed commit outcome promotes the exact runtime credential file atomically. No server-generated or browser-exposed Device private key.
smallest_coherent_next_launch_batch.unknown_outcome: Retry exact original key/credential/public-key/expiry/enrollment intent while the original token is valid. If token expiry prevents resolving a prior ambiguous consume, report UNKNOWN and retain local key; do not claim enrollment never committed or delete/rekey automatically. Decide a bounded exact authenticated current-credential enrollment-status confirmation route if launch recovery requires resolving that case after token expiry. Status cannot infer exact original enrollment intent from a generic live Device alone.
smallest_coherent_next_launch_batch.one_time_issue_delivery: Freeze one-time enrollment secret reveal/lost-response/reissue behavior against existing secret-handling rules. Salted token hashes do not recover a lost plaintext response. Do not fabricate exact secret replay; explicit revoke/reissue is a real lifecycle case.
smallest_coherent_next_launch_batch.deployment: Use existing runtime gateway credential secret reference and exact current file format. No identity grants, Kubernetes RBAC or server signing-key substitution. Existing M8-57c rendering reference criterion stays historical; bootstrap acceptance is an additional real launch prerequisite.
